name: Autocomplete field
summary: Type to get suggestions from a known list while still allowing free text — a framework-free combobox that embeds anywhere, slide canvas and audience phone included.
highlights: Suggestions from a known list, free text still allowed
Works on the slide canvas and the audience phone
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-autocomplete> — the LEAF counterpart to the composite Autocomplete (antd). It reuses the <aha-select> chrome (sizes 32 / 40 / 48, radius 8, border-input, brand focus border + ring, error / warning status, the same themed listbox popup with flip-above), so a build-less slide type gets a real owner / name picker instead of a hand-rolled <input> + <ul>. It follows the ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern with a list popup: the <input> is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant; the matching part of each suggestion is bold. The popup is a persistent node, so its fade / slide transition fires on open and close.

spec.label: Size
spec.value: small 32 · default 40 · large 48 (16px text — the audience phone size)

spec.label: Popup
spec.value: themed role=listbox, full field width, radius 8, elevation shadow, brand-tint active row, bold match; flips above near the viewport edge

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: "No matches" row (empty-text) — never an empty popup

props.name: options
props.desc: The suggestions — a JSON attribute or an `.options` property

props.name: value
props.desc: The typed text, or the picked option's value (the field shows its label)

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Hint shown when empty; also the accessible name unless aria-label is set

props.name: status
props.desc: Validation border colour; error also sets aria-invalid

props.name: empty-text
props.desc: Row shown when nothing matches — pass the translated text

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed event on every keystroke — the native input event also bubbles out, so read detail from the CustomEvent

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event when a suggestion is picked

whenToUse.when: free text where suggestions from a known list help — an owner, a name, a tag — on any surface, including build-less slide canvases and audience phones
the value MUST come from a short known set — no free text
a React / Vue app that needs grouped options, async loading or custom option rendering

opinion.note: Filter on the query (the element does a case-insensitive contains match). If the value must come from the list, use <aha-select> instead. Translate placeholder and empty-text.
opinion.dsv3: NEW leaf — the framework-free twin of the DS V3 AutoComplete, built on the Select field chrome so the two read as one family.

a11y.role: ARIA 1.2 combobox: <input role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded aria-controls aria-activedescendant> + role="listbox" of role="option"
a11y.keyboard: typing filters and opens; ArrowDown / ArrowUp open and move the active option; Alt+ArrowDown opens without moving; Enter picks; Escape closes, or clears when already closed; Tab closes; Home / End stay with the text caret
a11y.note: DOM focus never leaves the input — the active option is announced through aria-activedescendant, so typing and arrowing work together.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React < 19 sets `options` as a property through a ref; Vue binds `:options.prop`.

selfCheck.label: persistent popup node — fade / slide transition fires

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The probe is an empty <aha-autocomplete> with a placeholder.
